title: What Can Firms Do in the Face of Model Distillation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.38088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model distillation has become a major concern in the rapidly growing generative AI discourse. In its simplest form, distillation is the phenomenon where smaller firms can use data distilled from transcripts of conversations with powerful proprietary closed-weight models to train their own models, thus achieving reasonably high model quality but at much lower costs. Besides the legitimate safety and security concerns associated with distillation, another major issue is how it can also distort marketplace outcomes. This motivates us to initiate an exploration of the problem from an economic theory lens. We consider a setting with two players: an incumbent and a distilling competitor and characterize how the incumbent's model characteristics drive the incentives around how much the competitor should distill. translated_title: 面对模型蒸馏，企业能做什么？
translated_abstract: 模型蒸馏已成为快速发展的生成式AI讨论中的一个重大关切。在其最简单的形式中，蒸馏是指较小的公司可以利用从与强大的专有闭权重模型对话记录中蒸馏出的数据来训练自己的模型，从而以低得多的成本实现相当高的模型质量。除了与蒸馏相关的正当的安全与安保顾虑之外，另一个主要问题是蒸馏还可能扭曲市场结果。这促使我们从经济理论的视角出发，对这一问题展开探索。我们考虑了一个包含两个参与者的情境：一个在位企业和一个进行蒸馏的竞争者，并刻画了在位企业的模型特征如何决定竞争者在蒸馏程度上的激励。我们还考察了蒸馏对关键市场结果的影响，例如用户侧剩余和在位企业的效用。我们的关键贡献……
tldr: 本文从经济理论视角研究模型蒸馏现象，刻画了在位企业的模型特征如何影响蒸馏竞争者的蒸馏激励，以及蒸馏对用户剩余和在位企业效用等市场结果的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper studies model distillation through an economic theory lens, characterizing how an incumbent's model characteristics shape a distilling competitor's incentives and how distillation affects key market outcomes such as user-side surplus and the incumbent's utility.
